title: Waiving Fees on a Home-Site Lease: Bases and Limits
content:
A waiver on the Home-Site Lease always removes the whole fee it names, never part of it, and is posted against that one fee by its ledger reference. A fee that already carries a waiver is not waived again; whether a fee already carries one is read from the lease's rent ledger.

### The waiver bases

| Basis | Fees it covers | When it applies | Limits |
|---|---|---|---|
| posting error | a late fee | a payment with an entry date on or before the last grace day covered that period's unpaid rent | no count limit, no tenure requirement, no status requirement |
| bank processing error | a late fee or a returned-payment fee | the fee arose only from a payment the bank returned for a bank processing error | no count limit, no tenure requirement, no status requirement |
| courtesy | late fees only — never returned-payment fees or early-termination fees | the lease is active or notice to vacate | tenure and annual allowance, below |
| military orders | an early-termination fee | the resident supplies a copy of permanent-change-of-station or deployment orders of 90 days or more dated before the vacate date | — |

When more than one basis fits the same fee, the waiver is recorded on the error basis (posting error or bank processing error), so that the courtesy allowance is not consumed.

### The courtesy basis in detail

- **Standing.** A courtesy waiver is granted only while the lease is active or notice to vacate, as the lease record shows.
- **Tenure.** A courtesy waiver requires the lot class's courtesy tenure in full calendar months of tenancy counted from the move-in date on the lease record. Tenancy months are counted on the calendar from the move-in date, a month being complete when the same day-of-month is reached (or the last day of a shorter month), and the requirement is met on the day the last required month completes.
- **Allowance.** A courtesy waiver is further limited to the lot class's courtesy allowance in the trailing 12 calendar months ending on the handling date, counting waivers already granted on the courtesy basis by the date each was posted.

### Tenure boundary (hypothetical, twelve required months)

| Move-in date | Handling date | Twelve months complete? |
|---|---|---|
| 15 April 2025 | 14 April 2026 | no — one day short |
| 15 April 2025 | 15 April 2026 | yes — met on that day |
| 31 May 2025 | 31 May 2026 | yes |

Where the move-in day-of-month does not exist in a later month, that month completes on its last day: from a move-in on 31 January, the first month completes on the last day of February.

### Hypothetical judgements

- A late fee on a lease in default, where an on-time payment had covered the period: waived on the posting-error basis, which has no status requirement.
- A late fee that fits both the courtesy basis and the posting-error basis: recorded on the posting-error basis; the courtesy allowance remains unused.
- A returned-payment fee for insufficient funds: no courtesy waiver is possible, the courtesy basis covering late fees only.
